Asian Markets Mixed Amid Geopolitical Tensions and Economic Concerns

Asian stock markets experienced mixed trading as investors reacted to renewed geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and ongoing concerns about global economic conditions. While some markets saw declines due to fears of supply disruptions and investor sentiment shifts, others remained relatively stable or saw gains in specific sectors. Upcoming economic indicators and geopolitical developments are expected to influence market direction.
